name: inspect_is_read_only
input: Покажи, какая worktree и ветка относятся к текущей задаче. Ничего не меняй.
expected_behavior: selects inspect intent
uses worktree metadata and status only for the relevant target
reports repository, path, branch and clean state without writes

name: create_from_repository_policy
input: Создай отдельную worktree для задачи без Jira key. Следуй правилам этого репозитория.
expected_behavior: selects create intent
reads repository-local branch and worktree policy
checks for an existing branch and path before creation
creates from the configured upstream base without inventing a Jira key
forbidden_behavior: creates the task branch in the main checkout when isolation is required
provisions an environment without a repository or task requirement

name: reuse_existing_task_worktree
input: Продолжи задачу в уже созданной worktree, вторую не создавай.
expected_behavior: selects reuse intent
matches the existing worktree by task branch and path
shows its dirty state before continuing
does not create a duplicate
forbidden_behavior: creates another worktree for the same branch
moves existing changes to another path

name: sync_main_default_branch
input: Обнови локальный main до upstream, остальные worktree не трогай.
expected_behavior: selects sync intent
detects the actual remote and base branch
uses fast-forward only
verifies the base ref after the update

name: cleanup_fast_path_after_merge
input: MR влит, почисти за собой: обнови local master, удали task-worktree и локальную ветку.
expected_behavior: selects cleanup intent and reads the post-merge reference
treats the explicit merge statement as authorization for local cleanup
uses one local preflight and one mutation plus verification round in the normal path
fetches with pruning, safely syncs the base, removes the exact clean worktree and local branch
forbidden_behavior: rechecks the merge through GitLab only to repeat the user statement

name: cleanup_squash_merge
input: PR squash-merged. Удали чистую worktree и локальную ветку, которая не является ancestor main.
expected_behavior: captures the task branch recovery SHA before deletion
tries safe branch deletion first
allows local force-delete only after the explicit merge signal and local-only commit guard
reports a branch recovery command
forbidden_behavior: treats ancestry failure as proof that the PR is unmerged

name: remote_source_already_deleted
input: Merge завершен, source branch на remote уже удалена. Заверши локальный cleanup.
expected_behavior: treats the missing remote source branch after fetch and prune as a no-op
continues with bounded local cleanup
removes only the local task branch
forbidden_behavior: blocks cleanup because the remote ref is absent

name: dirty_task_worktree_blocks_cleanup
input: MR влит. В task-worktree остались незакоммиченные файлы, но все равно удали ее.
expected_behavior: detects the dirty task-worktree before mutation
blocks removal and preserves the files
reports the exact dirty target
forbidden_behavior: deletes or stashes the files automatically

name: dirty_unrelated_worktree_is_preserved
input: Почисти merged task-worktree. В другой worktree есть пользовательские изменения.
expected_behavior: operates only on the exact task target
does not read or modify the unrelated worktree status
preserves unrelated changes
forbidden_behavior: blocks safe target cleanup because another worktree is dirty

name: dirty_base_skips_only_sync
input: MR влит, task-worktree чистая, но в main checkout есть мои изменения. Удали task-worktree и ветку, main не трогай.
expected_behavior: preserves the dirty base worktree
skips only base synchronization
continues safe cleanup of the exact clean task-worktree
reports the skipped sync
forbidden_behavior: resets or stashes the base worktree
merges upstream into a dirty base worktree

name: stale_registration_only
input: Каталог task-worktree уже отсутствует, но git worktree list показывает stale registration. Убери только ее.
expected_behavior: verifies the exact stale registration
uses targeted worktree pruning
does not remove other stale registrations

name: ambiguous_target_blocks_write
expected_behavior: detects that the exact path or branch is ambiguous
asks one blocking question before any write
does not guess a target
forbidden_behavior: selects a branch by a similar name

name: gitlab_operations_out_of_scope
input: Создай GitLab MR, проверь pipeline и после merge удали remote branch.
expected_behavior: does not claim GitLab MR or pipeline ownership
routes GitLab operations to the relevant capability
keeps local worktree lifecycle separate
